# Models

> Explore models available on the OpenAI API.

If you're not sure where to start, use [GPT-Syn Astra](/api/docs/models/gpt-syn-astra.md), our flagship model for complex reasoning and coding. Choose [GPT-Syn Terra](/api/docs/models/gpt-syn-terra.md) to balance intelligence and cost.

> Prose mention of [GPT-Syn Prose](/api/docs/models/gpt-syn-prose-only) must never be extracted.

## Featured models

- [GPT-Syn Astra](/api/docs/models/gpt-syn-astra.md): Flagship complex reasoning and coding.
- [GPT-Syn Terra](/api/docs/models/gpt-syn-terra.md): Balanced intelligence and cost.
- [GPT-Syn Luna](/api/docs/models/gpt-syn-luna.md): Cost-sensitive, high-volume workloads.
